invariant: Transformation may change form, but it must not erase lineage.

planes.title: Observation
planes.purpose: Acquire signals without silently promoting them into claims.

planes.title: Interpretation
planes.purpose: Map patterns, incentives, boundaries, and causal trajectories.

planes.title: Continuity
planes.purpose: Preserve identity, provenance, rights, state, and transformation history.

planes.title: Production
planes.purpose: Transform approved material into bounded, reviewable artifacts.

planes.title: Release
planes.purpose: Verify, package, version, and route approved public objects.

planes.title: Commerce
planes.purpose: Execute explicit acquisition and licensing boundaries.

planes.title: Feedback
planes.purpose: Reconcile real-world evidence into revised models and decisions.

planes.title: Embodiment
planes.purpose: Bind sensing and action to local, physical, and authority-limited systems.
